The voice: CMU Flite speech synthesis (voice slt), its phoneme timing read from the synthesizer.
The mouth: ten profile visemes exposed from those phonemes; closed on every m.
The dog: drawn sprites selected on an exposure sheet; each answer scheduled from a sound.
The porch, the door, the light, the person: drawn in code. Sounds of the world: synthesized.
No footage and no photographs are used. Fonts: SIL Open Font License.
